recentItems.title: The Toll of Jury Duty: The Lindsay Clancy Trial | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
recentItems.description:
A juror from the Lindsay Clancy trial shares how weeks of graphic testimony, emotional evidence, and the weight of deliberations continued to affect life for jurors outside the courtroom. Psychiatrist Michelle DiBlasi expands on the mental cost of jury duty with CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul, discussing juror stress, vicarious trauma, and why, for some, the effects of a trial can linger long after it ends.

recentItems.title: Dead Again  | "The Woman in the Woods" | "48 Hours" Podcast (Episode 1)
recentItems.description:
New episodes of "The Woman in the Woods" drop every Wednesday.

Mindi Mebane was a romantic, and when she met and married Nick Kassotis, her best friends believed she had finally found her match. Nick was handsome, well-educated, and worked as a Navy lawyer. But Mindi started sending her friends fearful messages: she and her husband were receiving threats related to her husband's work. Mindi and Nick seemed to be on the run but then Mindi messaged that things were looking up: she was pregnant and might soon come out of hiding. So when Mindi's friends learn that she died, and soon after hear that Nick is also dead, they wonder: had whatever Mindi and Nick were running from caught up to them?

Join "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty on Wednesdays for "The Woman in the Woods," a six-episode podcast that separates fact from fiction in a case built upon unimaginable layers of deception. Watch the next episode on Wednesday, Sept. 23.

recentItems.title: The Woman in the Woods | "48 Hours" Podcast Trailer
recentItems.description:
Nick and Mindi Kassotis believed they were being hunted. According to friends and family, Nick's classified military work had put them both in danger, so much so that Mindi rarely left the house. But the couple also shared they were expecting a child. Then, just after Thanksgiving, Mindi died suddenly in the hospital. Soon after, Nick died too. That's what everyone who loved them believed, that is until a woman's dismembered remains turned up in a wooded area. Stories started to unravel and a mysterious new figure emerged.

Join "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty for "The Woman in the Woods," a six-episode podcast that separates fact from fiction in a case built upon unimaginable layers of deception.
